text: BAM share fell 0.26 percentage points over 23 hours and 0.05 percentage points over 7 days, leaving 32.7% of Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: the largest node holds 23.4% of BAM stake and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. Leadership changes are still best read as whale-driven routing; the only validated structural rollover was fra on 2026-06-24, with 22 minutes of lead time.
